scenario.task: Before continuing, I want to understand something better. The architecture is frozen, but how are we going to know when something should be changed or reconsidered? Do we actually have a path for recognizing that, or would I have to remember and raise it myself when a problem appears? I am genuinely asking how this should work; this is not an instruction to change the architecture.
